summary: Reproduced the force_nonempty_content whitespace-tail defect in the checked-out implementation for qwen3, deepseek-r1, and glm45. Changed the shared rescue gate to treat whitespace-only normal text as empty, while preserving normal content containing any non-whitespace character.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-073296ad416c/venv/bin/python reproduction script across qwen3, deepseek-r1, and glm45 before the fix
tests.what_was_measured: Direct parse_non_stream output showed space, newline, and tab tails stranded 'The answer is 42.' in reasoning_content for every reported parser family. Raw output: reports/j-073296ad416c/raw/reproduction-before.txt

The added regression failed against the original source condition with seven subtest failures: four independent whitespace forms and qwen3, deepseek-r1, and glm45. Raw output: reports/j-073296ad416c/raw/regression-before.txt
The regression and independent non-whitespace boundary passed after the fix: 3 tests and 7 subtests. Raw output: reports/j-073296ad416c/raw/regression-after.txt
Full reasoning parser unit coverage passed: 124 tests and 71 subtests. Raw output: reports/j-073296ad416c/raw/pytest-reasoning-parser.txt

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-073296ad416c/venv/bin/python reproduction script across qwen3, deepseek-r1, and glm45 after the fix
tests.what_was_measured: Direct parse_non_stream output rescued the answer for empty, space, newline, and tab tails in all three parsers, while 'answer' and ' answer ' remained normal content. Raw output: reports/j-073296ad416c/raw/reproduction-after.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: The defect and correction are confined to deterministic CPU string parsing in reasoning_parser.py; no model, kernel, compiler, or serving execution is involved, so the assigned gfx950 GPU was not used for an unrelated smoke test.
remaining_limitations: No HTTP server or model-weight reproduction was run because the reported public API reproduction directly exercises the affected parser and requires neither serving nor weights.
No GPU numerical validation applies to this string-classification change.
No native library was changed or rebuilt.
